title: Draft strip test clicks before the control appears
observed: Full browser runs failed because the unsent draft button was absent immediately after switching views.
expected: The test waits until the draft control is present before clicking it.
reproduction: Run the full UI suite under slower timing; feature draft survives polls can fail at the draft button click.
criteria: Discard the unsent draft before closing the sync-error test page, preserving subsequent browser tests.
evidence: Diagnosis: the preceding sync-error UI test left a dirty draft and an unload confirmation; discarding the draft before closing its page removed the interference. The affected sequence and full suite passed.
closureReason: Fixed and verified: the sync-error test discards its draft before closing; full suite passed.
